supported_claim: Cluster presence/frequency was evaluated across the available individuals represented in the retained scRNA manifest.
limitation: This is not equivalent to independent patient-level molecular validation across the bulk/CNV/clinical cohort.
interpretation: Supports reproducibility of cluster occurrence within the available scRNA datasets.

supported_claim: Retained scRNA metadata contain dataset, accession, cell_id and individual fields.
limitation: A universal patient_id/sample_id/case_id/donor_id/library_id linking scRNA cells to the bulk/CNV/clinical cohort is unavailable.
interpretation: No forced cell-to-patient or cell-to-molecular-modality linkage is made.

supported_claim: Individuals are represented within the four datasets.
limitation: Individuals are not shared across datasets.
interpretation: Cross-dataset recurrence is treated as replication across datasets, not paired longitudinal or matched-patient validation.
